set.body: At the pinned eyesim revision, cover eye_density, density_by, get_density, gen_density, suggest_sigma and sample_density. Exercise ks and MASS where supported, duration and explicit weights, sigma vectors, temporal windows, min_fixations, non-square bounds, edge behavior, interpolation and none/max/sum/zscore evaluation. Exit with dependency-locked fixtures, an independent small-grid Gaussian case, total out-of-domain behavior and portable JVM/Scala.js tests.
set.title: Pin KDE, bandwidth and density-evaluation conformance
